messages:
noah: Hi all — quick onboarding snag. I can log into Okta but the 1Password activation link says 'account mismatch' when I try to accept. I have both noah@redwood.com and noah.personal@mail.com in my HR intake.

it-ops: Hey @noah, sometimes HR sets the personal as primary. Which email did the invite go to?

noah: It went to the personal one. I tried to accept but Okta SSO then redirects to the corporate account and fails.

security: We see this often with duplicate identities. Two options: IT can reissue the invite to the corporate alias or we can create a temporary guest link so you can complete CLI setup. Which do you prefer?

noah: I'd prefer corporate alias for long-term, but guest for now would be great so I can access the sandbox.

it-ops: Sent a temporary guest invite to your personal email (expires 48h). Also flagged HR to flip primary to noah@redwood.com and will send canonical invite once done.

1password-bot: Guest invite sent to noah.personal@mail.com. To finish CLI sign-in, accept in browser and note the Secret Key.

noah: Guest accepted, browser flow worked. Quick related Q: Okta asked me to enroll MFA, but SMS failed (I have a +61 number). It allowed a 'use device passkey' option — is that good enough?

security: Yes, passkeys are preferred to SMS for international numbers. Enroll the browser or phone passkey and you should be fine. Note: if you plan to use hardware keys for repo SSH, that's separate and uses PIV.

noah: Enrolled passkey, and CLI signin succeeded after I copied the Secret Key. Thanks!

dev-rel: Nice, welcome! Small doc request: add a note to onboarding checklist to confirm primary email before sending 1Password invites and recommend passkeys for non-US hires.

it-ops: Agreed — I'll add that. Also created ticket IT-593 to update the invite checklist.

noah: Thanks everyone. Once HR flips primary, can someone merge the guest and main accounts? I don't want two records.

it-ops: We'll deprovision the guest after canonical account is active and reassign any shared vault permissions. Ping here when HR confirms.

noah: Will do. All working for now, appreciate the quick help :raised_hands:
